target_customer: Cosmetic and personal care brands, contract manufacturers, formulators and chemists that need ingredient search, formulation and compliance tools
problem: Developing cosmetic formulas relies on manual ingredient research, trial and error and compliance checks. Potion applies AI to ingredient management, formulation and regulatory screening.
business_model: Freemium software with a free discovery platform and sales-led premium plans and enterprise partnerships
product_category: AI software for product formulation (beauty R&D)

founders.name: Yahya Syed
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder and CEO in Crunchbase and a January 2026 news item per search results. No bio found.

founders.name: Hejab Malik
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No bio found.

founders.name: Alex Stec
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No bio found.

competitors.name: Turing (YC W20)
competitors.what: Machine learning to simulate ingredient combinations for home care, beauty and food and beverage formulations
competitors.traction_then: Revenue from eight brands of a large CPG company and a claimed $7M testing saving for one brand

competitors.name: Citrine Informatics
competitors.what: AI platform for materials and formulation, with a whitepaper on AI for formulations
competitors.funding_then: $7.6M Series A and a $20M Series B in 2019 per search results

technical_complexity.rationale: Predicting formulation outcomes needs chemistry data and models, and the company later patented a Virtual Formulation feature. Data access in 2021 was the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: An ingredient database and customer workspaces build some lock-in, but competitors such as Citrine and Turing worked on similar problems and large firms like L'Oreal partnered with IBM.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Potion announced a partnership with KDC/ONE in January 2026 per trade press.

market_need_then: Beauty and personal care formulators faced long reformulation cycles and compliance work, and AI formulation startups such as Turing were already selling to CPG firms in 2020. No quantified spend data was gathered.

branding.domain_note: Uses potion.ai, an exact name with the .ai extension.

identity.voice_and_tone: Optimistic and innovation-focused with a trust and security emphasis

branding.community_and_virality: A free discovery tool drew trade press such as CosmeticsDesign and a Formula Botanica podcast episode.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press and podcast coverage and a magic-themed real-word name suit beauty formulation, but no consumer-level community was found and other companies share the name.

outcome_analysis: Potion is active and moved from a general AI for product formulation pitch to a beauty industry focus with a free discovery platform, patented Virtual Formulation and a KDC/ONE partnership in January 2026. How much it raised is unclear because only aggregators report funding. No exit or shutdown found.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights reports $130K with a Y Combinator seed on Aug 30 2021, Seedtable lists Y Combinator with angels and 776, and Wellfound shows $6.1M total over 33 rounds, which conflicts. LinkedIn names Y Combinator, Offline Ventures, 776 Ventures and Tribe Capital. No press release or second outlet confirmed any round, so none is recorded.
